assessment.assessmentSubtitle: Record answers as reported. This page does not diagnose medical conditions.
assessment.noActiveSymptoms: No active symptoms are available yet.
assessment.severityRequiredSummary: Please select a severity level for all symptoms marked as present.
assessment.greenExplanation: None of the listed warning signs were reported.
assessment.greenAction: Continue routine care and seek medical advice if symptoms develop or worsen.
assessment.yellowExplanation: This assessment is incomplete because one or more answers were unknown.
assessment.yellowAction: Please complete the assessment or contact a qualified healthcare provider if you are concerned.
assessment.redAction: Please contact a qualified healthcare provider promptly.
assessment.diagnosisDisclaimer: This assessment does not diagnose medical conditions.
assessment.noFacilities: No healthcare facility information is available yet.
assessment.notedSymptoms: Also reported (not included in risk calculation)
assessment.notedDisclaimer: These symptoms were noted by the AI for reference but were not scored by the risk engine.
assessment.pretermLaborRiskExplanation: You are under 37 weeks and have signs of early labour (contractions, fluid leak, or severe abdominal pain). This could mean preterm delivery.
assessment.pretermLaborRiskAction: Go to the nearest hospital or call your doctor immediately. Do not wait.
assessment.posttermPregnancyExplanation: Your pregnancy is past 42 weeks. Overdue pregnancies carry higher risk for you and the baby.
assessment.posttermPregnancyAction: Please contact your doctor or midwife as soon as possible to discuss next steps.
assessment.ageRiskNoteAdvanced: Advanced maternal age (35+) — additional monitoring advised

checkIn.pageIntro: A few quick questions about how you are feeling this week.

milestone.FIRST_MOVEMENT: Around this week, many women feel their baby's first movements — we will ask about that too.
milestone.VIABILITY: Your baby is reaching an important stage of development — we will ask about the pattern of movements.
milestone.TERM_PREP: You are getting close to your due date — we will ask a few extra questions to prepare for delivery.

options.nausea_some: Some nausea, still managing to eat
options.nausea_cannot_keep_food: Cannot keep food or fluids down

fatigue.text: How is your energy and tiredness?

options.swelling_mild_ankles: Mild swelling of ankles or feet

options.headache_mild: Mild, goes away on its own

options.movement_none_hours: No movement felt in several hours

first_movement.text: Have you felt your baby's first movements?

movement_pattern.text: Is there a regular pattern to your baby's movements?

baby_position.text: Do you know your baby's position?

options.position_breech_or_sideways: I was told breech or sideways

contraction_frequency.text: If you have contractions, how far apart are they?

checkIn.freeTextLabel: Anything else you want to mention?
checkIn.freeTextHint: Optional. Anything you write here will be checked through a symptom assessment.
checkIn.incompleteHint: Please answer all questions to submit your check-in.
checkIn.advisoryTitle: Worth mentioning at your next visit

advisory.wellbeing_not_well: You mentioned not feeling well — do mention this at your next check-up.
advisory.nausea_cannot_keep_food: If you cannot keep food or fluids down, tell your doctor or LHW at your next visit.
advisory.fatigue_more_tired: Extra tiredness is common in pregnancy — rest when you can and mention it at your next visit.
advisory.fatigue_exhausted: Ongoing exhaustion can be a sign of anemia — mention it at your next visit.
advisory.spotting_light: Light spotting should be mentioned at your next visit. If it becomes heavier, please use the symptom check.
advisory.vision_slight_blurring: Mention any vision changes at your next visit.
advisory.first_movement_not_sure: If you have not felt movement by weeks 20-22, mention it at your next visit.
advisory.pattern_unclear: Try counting your baby's movements at the same time each day — mention what you notice at your next visit.
advisory.position_unsure: Ask at your next visit which position your baby is in.
advisory.position_breech_or_sideways: Babies can still turn on their own — ask your doctor about position at your next visit.

checkIn.routingFailedNote: We saved your check-in, but we could not complete the symptom check right now. Please use the standard symptom check.
checkIn.completedBody: Your Week {{week}} check-in is saved. A new check-in will be ready next week.
